basic_details.job_title: NIT Mizoram Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Stenographer Group, Technical Assistant and More Posts

Indian nationals must email the prescribed application form with documents and the fee receipt to [email protected]. The application must be received by 30 November 2026 (5:00 PM). content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications for all the non-teaching posts must be emailed to the Registrar In-Charge, NIT Mizoram, at [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026 (5:00 PM). Applications received after the last date and time will be summarily rejected. The application form is not supplied on postal request. Download the prescribed Application Form (Annexure-I) from the NIT Mizoram website www.nitmz.ac.in on A-4 size paper. Fill in the application form completely, including the Summary Sheet, the declaration and the fee payment details (Transaction Ref. No., Transaction Date, Bank, Amount). Fill in the Data Sheet (excel file); the notice says it must be sent along with the application. Pay the application fee through online payment to the institute's account and keep the payment receipt. Prepare soft copies (word file or pdf) of the completed form, all self-attested supporting documents, the Annexure(s) and the payment receipt. Email all of them to [email protected] so that they reach by 30 November 2026 (5:00 PM). Candidates already in service in Government, Semi Govt., PSUs, Universities or Educational Institutions should apply through Proper Channel or furnish a No Objection Certificate at the time of the Competitive Written Examination/Trade Test/Selection Committee; they may send an advance copy of the form. NIT Mizoram will not be responsible for any delay, loss or undelivered email. The fee must be paid through Online Payment Only to the account Name: NIT Mizoram MISC, A/C No.: 110258602373, Canara Bank, Aizawl, Mizoram, IFSC code: CNRB0003489. The payment receipt must be sent with the application form; an application without the payment receipt will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice states only the pay level and the minimum basic pay for each post; it names no allowances. First Class or equivalent Grade in B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA in relevant subject from a recognized University / Institute; OR First Class Diploma in Engineering in relevant Field with excellent academic record; OR First Class Bachelor's Degree in Science from a recognized University or Institute; OR Master's Degree in Science from a recognized University or Institute with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Essential: Senior Secondary (10+2) from recognized Board with minimum speed in short hand 80 w.p.m in Stenography. Desirable: Proficiency in Computer Word processing and spread-sheet with advance skills. Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science from a Government recognized Board with at least 60% marks; Or Senior Secondary (10+2) from a Government recognized Board with at least 50% marks and ITI Course of one year or higher duration in appropriate Trade; Or Secondary (10) with at least 60% marks and ITI Certificate of 2 years duration in appropriate Trade; Or Diploma in Engineering of three year's duration in Civil Engineering from a Government recognized Polytechnic / Institute. Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized Board. Candidates must attain 18 years of age. The upper limit is "not exceeding 30 years" for Technical Assistant and "not exceeding 27 years" for Stenographer, Technician and Office Attendant. The crucial date for age, qualifications and experience is the last date of submission of application, 30 November 2026 (till 5:00 PM). Date of Birth as per HSLC/HSC or Birth Registry will be accepted as age proof. Age relaxation in different categories shall be as per Government of India norms only. Only Indian nationals may apply. Experience of less than six months in any organisation will not be considered. OBC candidates must submit an OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026 (format at Annexure-III); otherwise the application will be considered in the Unreserved (UR) category only. PwD reservation benefit applies only to persons with not less than 40% disability; a certificate showing less than 40% will be rejected. The caste of SC/ST/OBC candidates must be in the relevant state-wise central list; certificates must be in the prescribed proforma issued by the authorities named in the GoI OMs quoted in the notice. Female candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are encouraged to apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed Application Form (Annexure-I) with a self-attested recent coloured passport photo affixed, and the Summary Sheet. Data Sheet (excel file). Fee payment receipt (not needed by fee-exempted women and PWD candidates). Self-attested copies of certificates and mark-sheets for every educational, technical or professional qualification claimed, and proof of date of birth. Experience certificate on the organisation's letter-head, showing date of issue, period of work, name and designation of the issuing authority, signature and official seal. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD certificate in the Govt. of India prescribed format (OBC-NCL issued on or after 1 April 2026). For in-service candidates: forwarding through Proper Channel or a No Objection Certificate, plus the Integrity Certificate and Vigilance Clearance Certificate in the format at Annexure-II.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: If applications are large in number, NIT Mizoram may shortlist candidates by methods it devises, including a Screening Test. Interviews stand discontinued for Group 'B' and Group 'C' posts; candidates will be recommended for appointment in order of merit on the basis of the Competitive Written Examination. The written papers are objective type. PwD candidates availing a scribe / reader / lab assistant get the compensatory time shown, and the minimum qualifying marks for Persons with Benchmark Disability are relaxable at the institute's discretion if enough reserved-category candidates are not available. Written examination of 200 marks (Paper I and Paper II), followed by a Trade Test of 50 marks that is qualifying in nature for those who secure the minimum qualifying marks. Ties are resolved by higher marks in Paper II, then higher marks in Part A of Paper I, then date of birth (older first), then alphabetical order. Written examination of 100 marks (Part A General Aptitude & Reasoning 30, Part B General Knowledge 30, Part C General English 40; minimum qualifying 30 marks; 2 hours plus 40 minutes compensatory time), followed by a qualifying Stenography Test. Transcription is on computer only and includes time for reconciliation. There is no exemption from the Stenography Test for any category; the institute may reduce the qualifying standard only for reserved posts without adequate candidates. Ties are resolved by higher marks in Part C, then date of birth (older first), then alphabetical order. Written examination of 100 marks: Part A General Aptitude & Reasoning (30), Part B General Science (30), Part C General Knowledge (40); minimum qualifying 30 marks; 2 hours plus 40 minutes compensatory time. Those who qualify will be called for a Trade Test of 50 marks (minimum qualifying 15, 45 minutes plus 20 minutes compensatory time), which is qualifying only. Ties are resolved by higher marks in Part A, then date of birth (older first), then alphabetical order. A qualifying Trade Test of 50 marks is held first – either Knowledge of Basic Computer Applications (Word Processing, Spread Sheet etc.) OR a Driving Test (2 wheeler/Light Vehicle) under the supervision of MVI. Candidates securing 20 marks and above qualify for the written examination of 100 marks: Part A General Aptitude & Reasoning (30), Part B General Knowledge (30), Part C General English (40); minimum qualifying 30 marks; 2 hours plus 40 minutes compensatory time. Questions will be of a level an average matriculate can answer. Ties are resolved by Part A marks, then Part C marks, then date of birth (older first), then alphabetical order.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Technical Assistant, 1 Stenographer, 1 Technician and 2 Office Attendant posts, all unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by email by 30 November 2026 (5:00 PM); applications received later will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the prescribed application form, Data Sheet (excel file), self-attested documents and fee receipt in soft copy (word file or pdf) to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Office Attendant and Stenographer posts?
faq.answer: Office Attendant needs Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized Board; Stenographer needs Senior Secondary (10+2) with minimum shorthand speed of 80 w.p.m.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 30 years for Technical Assistant and not exceeding 27 years for the other posts, counted on 30 November 2026; candidates must have attained 18 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NIT Mizoram non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: Minimum basic pay is ₹35,400.00 (Level 6) for Technical Assistant, ₹25,500.00 (Level 4) for Stenographer, ₹21,700.00 (Level 3) for Technician and ₹18,000.00 (Level 1) for Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹1000/- for General and OBC and ₹500/- for SC/ST candidates, paid online only; women and PWD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an interview?
faq.answer: Interviews stand discontinued for Group 'B' and Group 'C' posts; appointment is in order of merit based on the Competitive Written Examination, with qualifying trade, stenography or driving tests.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the examination?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Trade Test or Competitive Written Examination.

faq.question: Q10. Within how long must selected candidates join?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must join within one month from the date of Declaration of Results / Offer of Appointment.
